title: FREE REQUEST I want your help to make some cool music! [OPEN]

posts.author: RyanJimenez
posts.body:
Hello Everyone! I am Ryan Jimenez and I need your help. I have a video game that I would like to make called Solitude. It is a horror game with RPG elements. I write the story and create the art in RPG Maker XP.
What I need help from you is some music tracks. I like diverse music tracks, so I would like to see what you can create. I am into horror music and some rap music or retro. Try old school music from the 20th century and that's very cool.
Even if your song does not go in the game, I will still post it on my YouTube channel as a part of the game's development history.
I would like my tracks short. 30 seconds - 2 minutes.
If you do make the songs, I will post them on my Youtube channel and credit you.
Link in the description:
https://www.youtube.com/@ninjateam9751
I would also try to promote your songs on Japanese YouTube like NicoNico if you want that.
Here's some artwork that I developed, very basic but I try my best and never give up!
Thank you all, and have a great day!

posts.author: Not-Red
posts.body: Ooohh, that looks cool! I can try make some ambient/sample based silent hill-esque music, but I'm gonna need some more info. What part of the game should I make music for? What vibe do you need? Can I have some gameplay footage to get a sense of how it plays?

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
Your best bet is probs search the internet as there is a lot of free to use music out there.
Just make sure it's ok to be used correctly if you go commercial with it.
I think you'll get more offers if you are more specific about what music you want.
And I think the issue about you adding people's music to your own channel isn't going to be enough and might put some people off.
And I think it might be better if you go on Resource request as it seems it's mainly music you're looking to get.
